title: The Protocol of Kowloon Revisited
author: Bram Fairweather
blurb: Coral Okonkwo, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
